title: Main /cards runtime uses legacy authority loader instead of the canonical cards runtime stack
evidence: `v1_cards.py` calls `cards_service`; `cards_service` delegates to `app.runtime.cards_logic`; that code calls `load_authority_cards()`. The newer `app.cards.runtime` repository stack is not authoritative for the live `/cards` router.
recommended_fix: Move the live `/cards` router onto one canonical authority path, preferably the canonical cards runtime repository stack, and retire the legacy loader.
fastest_method: Repoint `/cards` to the canonical runtime service and add a compatibility adapter for existing response envelopes if needed.
verification_steps: Trace `/cards/deck` and `/cards/session/adaptive/start` end to end and prove a single authority path with fixture-backed tests.

title: Runtime authority merges published and legacy donor banks, creating severe drift and duplication
evidence: Runtime total is 35149 cards, with 28842 legacy and 6307 published. Exact duplicate groups: 13009; duplicate rows: 21946.
recommended_fix: Stop loading both the split published tree and the legacy donor banks into the same live bank. Deduplicate before publication, not at selection time.
fastest_method: Create a single canonical publication manifest and have the live runtime read only that manifest-backed dataset.
verification_steps: Reduce duplicate rows to near-zero for exact duplicates and rerun duplicate_report.csv after publication.

title: Published grammar cards exist but are silently dropped by the live runtime loader
evidence: Published grammar files contain canonical `grammar_card` entries, but `load_authority_cards()` emitted runtime content types only for `sentence_card` and `vocabulary_card`. The loader looks for `front.term|sentence|text`, while grammar cards use `front.rule_label|pattern|example`.
recommended_fix: Either make the live runtime consume canonical card envelopes directly or add explicit grammar-card mapping in the legacy loader.
fastest_method: Retire the legacy loader; if that is not possible, patch `_load_published_cards()` to map grammar front/back schema correctly and add tests.
verification_steps: After fix, runtime bank stats must include grammar cards and `/cards/deck?content_type=grammar_card` must return non-empty results.

title: Published general cards are mislabeled as professional in the live runtime loader
evidence: Runtime stats show `path {"professional": 35149}` even though published samples from `kielitaika_normalized_cards.json` have `path: general`. `_load_published_cards()` hardcodes `path = professional`.
recommended_fix: Preserve the canonical `path` field from published cards instead of forcing `professional`.
fastest_method: Read `item["path"]` directly and add a schema consistency test between canonical payload and runtime materialization.
verification_steps: Rerun runtime stats and confirm general/professional split matches source data.

title: Vocabulary cards in the live bank are dominated by low-retrieval donor templates
evidence: Legacy donor items repeat the same token across recognition, recall, reverse, completion, and context_mcq variants; examples include `prompt: potilas, answer: potilas` and `prompt: lääkäri, answer: lääkäri`. This supports recognition loops more than meaningful recall or communicative production.
recommended_fix: Use curated vocabulary cards with meaningful gloss, collocation, and context instead of token-self-matching drills; keep only the strongest donor rows after dedupe and prompt redesign.
fastest_method: Transform curated `sanasto/*` packs into canonical vocabulary cards and quarantine low-value legacy rows.
verification_steps: Sample 100 vocabulary cards and confirm prompts test meaning/use rather than identity matching.

title: Phrase/sentence bank contains large volumes of generic or article-derived filler rather than reusable workplace chunks
evidence: Top duplicate groups are long article fragments such as surgical infection prose and medical-history filler. The practical nurse external phrase pack also contains generic lifestyle lines like winter holiday and furniture shopping, which do not justify profession routing.
recommended_fix: Curate phrase banks around high-value formulaic workplace chunks, then deduplicate long article-derived sentence debris.
fastest_method: Promote curated `fraasit/*` cards, demote or discard long completion fragments, and enforce maximum sentence length / formulaic-use checks in validation.
verification_steps: Top duplicate groups should no longer be article fragments; sampled phrase cards should read like reusable healthcare interaction chunks.

title: CEFR/YKI progression is structurally weak in the live bank
evidence: Level distribution in the live bank is overwhelmingly B1_B2 (34348 of 35149). Legacy donor banks have no robust can-do progression and the live `/cards` path is mostly lexical recall or sentence translation, not YKI-like task performance.
recommended_fix: Assign credible level bands at publication time and tie cards to communicative can-do outcomes rather than flat token frequency dumps.
fastest_method: Normalize levels during import, preserve curated A1/A2 and C1/C2 packs, and add validation checks for level balance by profession and card type.
verification_steps: Recompute level distribution and review a stratified sample per level band.

title: Doctor bank lacks key work-to-language domains despite large size
evidence: Doctor coverage ratios are near-zero for handover (0.0), documentation (0.48%), emergency (0.20%), consent/privacy (0.07%), elderly/home-care (0.28%), and family/empathy (0.26%).
recommended_fix: Add doctor-specific chunks for informed consent, explaining findings, treatment planning, urgent escalation, documentation, and relative communication.
fastest_method: Start from curated doctor phrase/vocab/grammar packs, then add manual high-value scenario sets for missing domains.
verification_steps: Coverage ratios for the missing domains should materially increase and samples should be patient-facing doctor interaction, not article prose.

title: Nurse bank has the strongest current profession fit but still undercovers handover, privacy, and emergency language
evidence: Nurse coverage includes stronger patient, medication, and documentation examples than the other professions, but handover is only 0.02%, consent/privacy 0.17%, and emergency 0.34% of the bank.
recommended_fix: Preserve the strongest nurse scenario cards and add missing shift-handover, escalation, confidentiality, and team-communication clusters.
fastest_method: Promote curated nurse phrase/grammar packs and author a compact set of missing high-value chunks manually.
verification_steps: Rerun coverage CSV and sample at least 50 nurse cards from the added domains.

title: Practical nurse bank mixes some strong care-work cards with heavy generic clutter and article debris
evidence: Practical nurse coverage shows zero handover and only 0.13% consent/privacy, while external phrase samples include unrelated lifestyle content such as ski holidays and furniture shopping under the profession label.
recommended_fix: Separate useful care-work foundation from generic everyday clutter and rebuild the practical nurse track around direct care, home care, dementia, documentation, and relative communication.
fastest_method: Deduplicate, discard generic filler, and import only curated practical nurse cards that map to care-work scenarios.
verification_steps: A post-fix practical nurse sample should contain mostly care-work and home-care interaction language, not generic household sentences.

title: External compiled bank has high-value curated packs, but its aggregate combined files are unsafe donor material
evidence: Combined files contain English-heavy noise such as `health`, `that`, `public`, `also`, and parliamentary English sentence recalls. In contrast, curated fraasit/sanasto/kielioppi packs are runtime-shaped and profession-linked.
recommended_fix: Treat combined files as donor-only mining sources; integrate curated packs and structured new_practice packs first.
fastest_method: Build a Python normalization pipeline that ingests curated and new_practice packs, while filtering combined files through Finnish-only and profession-validity checks before any reuse.
verification_steps: Imported rows should come primarily from curated and structured packs; combined-file imports should require quarantine and review.

title: External cards/*.json bank is already imported verbatim into the live legacy bank
evidence: SHA-256 comparison showed the three external `cards/*.json` files are byte-identical to the local `practice/data/cards/*.json` donor banks.
recommended_fix: Do not re-import these files. Focus on deduplicating or retiring them.
fastest_method: Mark them as already integrated in the pipeline manifest and exclude from future imports.
verification_steps: Hash-compare before import and reject identical sources.

title: Fastest safe improvement path is a Python normalization + dedupe + publication pipeline anchored to one authority
evidence: Curated external packs are structured enough for automated conversion; the main blocker is not extraction but authority drift and publication discipline.
recommended_fix: Implement a Python pipeline with stages: inventory -> normalize -> dedupe -> tag -> validate -> publish -> smoke test. Keep manual review only for high-risk semantic domains.
fastest_method: Python, using existing canonical schemas in `apps/backend/app/cards/schemas` and adapter logic similar to `new_practice_repository.py`.
verification_steps: Pipeline should emit deterministic manifests, duplicate reports, and validation failures before publication.
